title: CY50101: Electrochemistry

Prerequisite: NilGeneral Introduction, Electrified Interfaces: Electric double
layer; Helmholtz and Gouy-Chapman models; double-layer capacitance; specific
and non-specific adsorption; Debye-HÃ¼ckel theory. Mass Transfer: Modes of mass
transfer; electrolyte conductance; the role of the supporting electrolyte; iR
drop and strategies for minimizing it; membrane liquid junction potentials;
the diffusion coefficient; Fick s Laws of diffusion; concentration-distance
